admission: Admit only complete directed stop patterns on explicitly mapped operator/line geometry. All source calls, branches, call rules and border termini retained. Every pair must pass projection, connectivity and detour checks. Historic official corridor inference, not certified street directions, current diversions or observed movement. Three individually pinned sub-metre topology connectors are inferred and reported per pair and trip; no other gap filling.
scopeLimits: Annual membership is complete for the pinned national timetable and official canton polygon, not proof of unrepresented real-world services.
Friday/Sunday plus preceding-day carry-in do not establish seasonal, holiday or year-round coverage.
No-stop through traffic is outside this passenger-service inventory.
Geometry admission covers only the mapped official Buslinien source. Rail, mountain, boat and unmatched bus routes remain in the coverage denominator.
The WFS matches the archive within 1 mm but proves no 2026 alignment validity. No realtime.

topologyJoins.method: Three explicitly reviewed sub-metre source endpoint-to-vertex discontinuities on identical line labels. Short straight connectors are inferred geometry, not publisher linework. No automatic proximity joins.
